g.text: Eight-model performance on identical six candidate trajectories
nuScenes custom scene-isolated CV; 630 scenes; Overall n=260,151; V n=191,026; P n=66,145; Moving V n=41,728
HitRate: selected mode equals endpoint-FDE oracle (not a distance-threshold success rate). Parameters: scoring head only.
Compute: equal fold means; cached head forward and full path on 16 fixed InnerDev windows. Excludes raw I/O; actor counts vary by fold.
Adapted TNT uses frozen HiVT context; the external comparison is supplementary and not an official leaderboard result.
